summary: task(setings): Validate that new wc commands and pref activate
description:
Because:
- We want to do a preliminary check that the new paring.version pref added to Firefox works
- We want to do a preliminary check that the new `fxaccounts:pair_oauth_start` wc cmd works
- We want to do a preliminary check that the new `fxaccounts:pair_oauth_finish` wc cmd works

This Commit:
- Wires up the `/pair2/authority/scan_qr` code route for testing purposes.
- Checks for the `v=2` query param on CAD and navigates users to `/pair2/authority/scan_qr`.
- Tries to have the launcher set 'identity.fxaccounts.pairing.version' to 2 by default
- Adds support for the new web-channel command to `firefox.ts`
- Excercises the new wc commands on `/poc_pair_start`.
